versions.changelog:
Initial release of 欧路词典生词本管理与每日测试技能 (eudic-vocab):

- Automatically generates daily vocabulary quizzes from your 欧路词典 word list
- Intelligent distractor options and answer checking with explanations
- Manage vocabulary: list or delete mastered words
- Easy setup with API Token and daily cron scheduling
- Command line tools for quiz generation and vocabulary management
